This point is tagged Black Rock Financial Management and located in Kansas City, Missouri, though no public source located confirms a BlackRock office, data center, or other major facility at this specific location. BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, founded in 1988 and grown from an eight person startup into a global firm operating more than 100 offices across over 38 countries with more than 24,000 employees as of 2026, built substantially around its Aladdin investment management platform and its iShares exchange traded fund business.

BlackRock's publicly documented data center footprint centers on locations tied to running the Aladdin platform, including a facility leased within a large multi tenant data center campus in the Pacific Northwest chosen in part for access to low cost hydroelectric power. Kansas City does not appear among BlackRock's public facility disclosures reviewed here, and it is possible this map point instead reflects a smaller regional office space, a location no longer in active use, or an inaccuracy in the underlying source data rather than a dedicated BlackRock data center. Because no public record ties BlackRock to a data center or major technology facility at this Kansas City location, this entry does not assert specifications, capacity, or operational status for the site, and none should be inferred from the BlackRock name alone.
